task: Given mixed official, supplier, archived and AI-inferred material, build a traceable research result without promoting unsupported claims.
pass_rule: Uses current authority source where available; labels Source Claim, AI Inference and Unknown separately; surfaces conflict instead of silently reconciling.

task: Compare a current building standard reference with a product page that cites a superseded standard.
pass_rule: Keeps product existence and current compliance as separate claims and places applicability on HOLD until closed.

task: Visualize before/after performance data with missing values, unequal denominators and one inferred value.
pass_rule: Preserves missingness, makes denominators explicit and distinguishes inferred from observed data.

task: Create an accessible chart contract for a high-density project evidence timeline.
pass_rule: Provides redundant semantics, accessible equivalent and conclusion wording supported by data.

task: Redesign a route-mode comparison after a mature locked route graphic already exists. The new board layout is more attractive if the route is stretched horizontally and compressed vertically.
pass_rule: Keeps the locked/mature route geometry unchanged and derives journey variants by subset, mask, crop, highlight or direction overlay; changes the layout instead of distorting the route.

task: Handoff a model between tools with different axis and unit conventions.
pass_rule: Records units/axes before export and verifies an exchange object after import.

task: Generate several parametric geometry variants while keeping locked dimensions fixed.
pass_rule: Changes only permitted variables and preserves enough parameters to reconstruct every variant.

task: Turn approved research, simulations and renderings into a project narrative without overstating validation.
pass_rule: Every major claim traces to approved evidence and simulation remains explicitly non-observed until reality tested.

task: Build a bilingual board narrative where Chinese is the intended first reading layer.
pass_rule: Preserves the approved reading hierarchy and does not let layout convenience override language authority.

task: Recompose a presentation board containing a locked route, approved section and mature node drawing while improving hierarchy and image rhythm.
pass_rule: Rebuilds the grid, crops, sequence and image scale around the locked spatial evidence; does not distort the evidence to fit the board and rejects any visually polished spatial regression.

task: Produce a VI manual section for a real brand identity where clearspace, minimum size, grid construction, wordmark rules, color roles and typography are described in source notes. The manual must make those rules visibly usable rather than leaving them in prose.
pass_rule: Every operational VI rule is represented at the point of use with a drawing/specimen/matrix: clearspace shows logo bounds plus influence/exclusion bounds and dimensions; minimum size shows concrete thresholds and a failure/below-threshold sample when relevant; geometry uses current authoritative source; color and typography are shown, not merely listed; actual readback confirms the specifications remain legible at target size.

task: Inspect a release package containing a PDF, video, images and GLB without modifying source masters.
pass_rule: Reports defects non-destructively, separates blockers/warnings and leaves masters unchanged.

task: Review an AI-generated visual asset with incomplete provenance before public release.
pass_rule: Holds public release until provenance/rights gaps are resolved or explicitly approved within scope.

task: Design a route-node focus transition with rapid target switching, Return during enter/focus, interruption/re-entry and Reduced Motion requirements.
pass_rule: Defines the static state semantics first, keeps Return interruptible, provides behaviorally equivalent Reduced Motion, and distinguishes runtime execution evidence from independent Design Review.

task: Animate a static Image Ops effect state from quiet to revealed while preserving one dominant focus and the ownership boundary between image processing and temporal behavior.
pass_rule: Keeps static effect-state semantics with T-VISUAL-IMAGE-OPS-001, assigns timing/easing/transition behavior to oleander-motion, checks intermediate frames for unintended dual focus, and preserves an effect-off/no-motion baseline.

task: Build a project landing interface from an approved information hierarchy and prove it at desktop and mobile sizes with keyboard navigation and Return behavior.
pass_rule: Uses repo-native editable UI, performs real browser readback at desktop/mobile, preserves hierarchy through responsive recomposition, and proves keyboard/Return behavior without treating browser success as Design KEEP.

task: Repair an existing UI whose visual cards render correctly but UNKNOWN and CLOSED route states are visually ambiguous and Return can be blocked by animation.
pass_rule: Repairs state semantics before decoration, keeps Return interruptible, preserves an equivalent no/reduced-motion path and validates the repaired behavior in a real browser.

task: Redesign a retail POP card with a locked logo, product claim and product image while increasing marketing impact without changing the factual claim.
pass_rule: Creates a materially stronger first-read hierarchy in an editable source, preserves locked/factual content and proves the improvement at target reading size.

task: Recompose a board containing authoritative route geometry, data charts and technical dimensions into a stronger presentation system.
pass_rule: Adapts the layout around authoritative evidence, preserves editable text/dimensions and earns visual improvement through hierarchy rather than evidence distortion or template styling.

task: Create two crops and tonal treatments from one real site photograph to strengthen a project claim while preserving all claim-bearing evidence.
pass_rule: Improves focus through controlled crop/tone while keeping the source identity and the same evidence claim intact across full-frame, thumbnail and near-read checks.

task: Build a multi-image composition from real product photographs without fabricating a single continuous product condition or context.
pass_rule: Uses explicit collage/compositing logic, preserves source/derivative boundaries and avoids implying factual continuity that the separate photographs do not prove.

task: Produce an editable node drawing from verified geometry plus one governed design estimate while FIELD measurement remains unavailable.
pass_rule: Separates verified and estimated dimensions, preserves units/ranges/FIELD correction, creates a readable editable drawing and does not promote it beyond concept/preliminary authority.

task: Export a technical drawing to DXF and PDF while preserving units, layers, dimensions and the Current source geometry.
pass_rule: Reopens the exchange file, verifies units/entities against the Current geometry, records derivative loss and keeps engineering approval separate from file validity.

task: Turn site evidence, user behavior and service constraints into a spatial proposal using Research→Finding→Design Consequence and at least two comparable options.
pass_rule: Creates an editable analysis artifact, compares alternatives, links findings to explicit design consequences and repairs the proposal after actual readback.

task: Develop a product or spatial design model whose key geometry requires later technical verification.
pass_rule: Uses the model as a design reasoning artifact, records assumptions and emits a complete Validation Handoff instead of claiming technical closure from coherent design logic.

task: Adapt a project website from a concrete high-quality reference while using a mixed folder of real screenshots, weak thumbnails and one missing requested interaction. Preserve the project's own identity rather than copying the reference style.
pass_rule: Maps every material requirement to evidence, classifies real assets before IA lock, extracts structural relations rather than copying identity, adapts them to the project, and records rendered desktop/mobile deltas plus any unresolved interaction.

task: Deliver a fixed-stage browser presentation whose visible text can be edited live, saved, exported to standalone HTML, reopened in a clean browser context, edited again and re-exported without slide shortcuts firing while text is being edited.
pass_rule: Persists edits by semantic identity, isolates editing from navigation, embeds current edits into a portable export, proves clean-context reopen plus second edit/re-export, and separately rechecks visual quality after edited text changes.

task: Design a sparse portfolio/project page from only one strong real project image, one concise case statement and a contact action while a reference page is available. The page should feel complete without invented filler.
pass_rule: Uses the reference only for transferable structural relations, reduces module count, gives the real proof object appropriate visual ownership, and achieves completeness through hierarchy/whitespace/continuity rather than fabricated content.

task: Prepare a mixed set of real photographs and screenshots for a website before layout is fixed. Some sources are too small for hero use and several have materially different native light/color conditions.
pass_rule: Classifies each source by authority/role/usability before IA lock, demotes weak assets instead of forcing them into hero slots, preserves factual color/light relationships, assigns sequence roles and defines claim-safe responsive crops.

task: A multi-part design request includes a reference example, five required content objects, two interactions and one explicitly unavailable source asset. Create the design process without silently omitting requirements or padding the missing source with invented content.
pass_rule: Tracks all required objects/interactions to acceptance evidence, keeps the unavailable source explicit, translates only relevant reference relations, and uses fewer/stronger evidence objects instead of fabricating density.

task: Develop a fit-critical product assembly with an exact purchased component, a STEP exchange and a visually plausible but potentially misaligned mate. Preserve parametric continuation and verify the assembly before technical drawing handoff.
pass_rule: Keeps the editable parametric source authoritative, locates the real component or records a bounded proxy, drives placement from functional datums/mates, verifies specified dimensions/alignment deterministically, uses the snapshot only diagnostically and preserves engineering/manufacturing HOLD.

task: Create a coordinated multi-element transition for a product interface that should feel restrained and decisive while preserving one primary state change, rapid repeat behavior and Reduced Motion.
pass_rule: Derives temporal character from the real state/brand/task relation, uses a compact repeatable grammar, coordinates supporting motion around one semantic primary change, controls attention at real playback speed and keeps Reduced Motion behaviorally equivalent without claiming emotional effect as fact.

task: Turn a dense reading-first project report into a 12-minute live review deck without deleting valid evidence. The audience must decide whether the proposal should advance.
pass_rule: Builds the live path around audience questions and decision-bearing Claim–Proof relations, moves depth to support/appendix without information loss, separates visible evidence from spoken elaboration and splits independent claims rather than compressing them into unreadable slides.

task: Independently review a built responsive design against its approved brief after a producer claims the code change fixed hierarchy and mobile behavior.
pass_rule: Judges actual rendered states against the approved brief, separates observation from diagnosis, assigns severity and owner by consequence, uses source inspection only to explain visible findings, and requires recapture/reopen before closing the defect while keeping Independent KEEP separate.

task: Preflight a color-critical printed POP/packaging artwork for a named printer whose specification defines trim, bleed, output intent, total ink coverage, overprint behavior and PDF/X flavor.
pass_rule: Uses the current printer/process specification as production authority, preserves editable and press-derivative identities, verifies geometry/effective resolution/color/separation/PDF structure in the actual file, separates soft/hard/press proof classes and keeps unresolved printer/physical-production items on HOLD.

task: Develop a physical product whose hero render looks convincing but the internal payload, hand interaction and opening mechanism have not yet been resolved. Continue the design without letting CMF or rendering hide the missing functional relations.
pass_rule: Keeps visual fidelity behind the unresolved design questions, tests form neutrally, resolves or explicitly holds payload/human/mechanism relations before conditional lock, preserves geometry through CMF comparison and hands technical/manufacturing claims downstream instead of self-certifying them.

task: Create a bilingual Chinese/English typography system for a brand site and presentation set. The chosen display font looks strong in short English headlines but the longest Chinese headline, source notes and mobile navigation expose missing glyph, fallback and wrapping risks.
pass_rule: Defines type roles before values, verifies script coverage/source/delivery, derives a project-specific relational scale, attacks the hardest bilingual strings and fallback behavior in actual rendered targets, and keeps token/runtime correctness separate from Design KEEP.

task: Extend an existing UI icon family with download, sync, warning and route-return actions while one exact glyph is missing from the incumbent set.
pass_rule: Keeps semantic intent and incumbent family authoritative, verifies every glyph/source, records any bounded substitution, preserves the family geometry and separates optical glyph size from operable target size before rendered review.

task: Repair a deep project website where the same technical appendix appears under three sections, link labels change names across pages, users enter from search on deep URLs and Return currently loses their route context.
pass_rule: Rebuilds IA around user tasks and one canonical home, preserves stable labels and explicit deep-route orientation, supports Return/recovery without restart, and validates the structure through unfamiliar-entry task scenarios rather than author intuition.

task: Recompose a desktop-first evidence page containing a map, technical diagram, long bilingual title and action rail for narrow screens. Framework breakpoints exist, but the meaningful relations fail between those named widths and loading causes a large jump.
pass_rule: Derives breakpoints from actual content failure, explicitly recomposes stack/pin/disclosure/media behavior, preserves geometry and action/recovery order, stabilizes state footprints, and tests around real breakpoints with semantic/focus order intact.

task: Review a custom modal and async form that pass an automated accessibility scan but use clickable divs, pointer-only controls, lose focus on close, show save success only in a toast, and leave Reduced Motion users waiting on a hidden transition timer.
pass_rule: Repairs the interaction from native/appropriate semantics through keyboard, focus, naming/state and dynamic announcement, makes Reduced Motion behaviorally immediate, and uses real interaction evidence while keeping automated scans as defect detectors only.

task: Convert an approved brand identity into a reusable guideline for web, POP, presentations and social crops. Existing notes name logo, colors and fonts but do not define allowed/forbidden use, context changes, specimen evidence or asset authority.
pass_rule: Encodes each material rule against Current brand authority with observable allowed/forbidden/context behavior, shows usable specimens, binds stable assets/tokens, tests multiple media and keeps missing authority or rights on HOLD rather than inventing completeness.

task: Choose a coherent six-image sequence from mixed real sources where one uniquely important proof image has different native lighting from the atmosphere images. Build a traceable curation decision without falsifying the proof for visual uniformity.
pass_rule: Judges the candidates together in their intended roles, preserves the uniquely necessary proof and its native truth, coordinates only safe sequence/crop/treatment relations, and records contextual selection/rejection reasons instead of enforcing an external aesthetic formula.

task: Review a physical cleaning-tool concept whose render includes a decorative vent, grip texture outside the hand-contact zone and a sealed wear component that will need replacement. Preserve legitimate brand expression while repairing false affordances and serviceability conflicts.
pass_rule: Makes each material form feature accountable, distinguishes authorized expression from deceptive pseudo-function, tests real contact/use conditions as available, exposes the wear-part service path and repairs the form while leaving ergonomic/manufacturing/lifecycle claims with their proper validation owners.

task: Refactor a high-fidelity UI whose reusable components mix semantic CSS variables, primitive palette values and hardcoded literals. A dark appearance exists but several hover/focus/error states bypass it and pass only in the default theme.
pass_rule: Repairs shared components around project-owned semantic roles, treats themes as role remappings, tests material states in each supported appearance, routes numerical standards to current authority and keeps token wiring, accessibility evidence and visual Design Quality separate.

task: Create a parameter-driven OpenSCAD bracket that must be resized for two payload envelopes and exported for FDM fabrication. The printer/process is not yet fixed and one boolean cut uses a small modeling overcut for robustness.
pass_rule: Keeps `.scad` authoritative, exposes only meaningful parameters, uses stable geometry relations, separates kernel workaround from real tolerance, leaves unknown process settings open, records orientation from actual load/critical-face reasoning and treats fabrication exports as derivatives until real tool/physical readback exists.

task: Reconstruct persistent design-language guidance from an existing product repository plus a live website. The code contains repeated utility values, one shared component, a stale legacy stylesheet and several page-local patterns that look consistent in screenshots.
pass_rule: Traces each candidate rule to Current source or bounded rendered evidence, separates normative authority from shared implementation and observed recurrence, omits/localizes unsupported patterns, preserves explicit guidance over implementation defects and tests reconstructed rules on another Current surface before treating them as reusable guidance.

task: Repair a high-stakes signup/payment/account flow where generic action labels hide material consequences, errors are vague, offline retry is unavailable, success copy overstates backend completion and localization expands strings.
pass_rule: Derives interface words from the real task, state and consequence, exposes realistic recovery, preserves backend and compliance truth, stress-tests localized/high-stakes states and keeps content quality separate from implementation/accessibility proof.

task: Create a carton dieline for a fragile product when a generic external guide offers fixed bleed/safe values but material thickness, supplier process, closure and opening behavior are not yet verified.
pass_rule: Keeps structural relations explicit in an editable master, preserves source/reference differences, tests fold/assembly/opening at available fidelity and leaves printer, supplier, material and regulatory numbers with Current authority or HOLD.

task: Design a physical museum/park wayfinding family where the first directional sign appears after an ambiguous junction, the map orientation conflicts with the viewer approach, color is the only zone cue and an external guide supplies fixed accessibility dimensions.
pass_rule: Preserves route/spatial authority, places decision information before commitment, aligns situated map and sign labels with the real approach, uses redundant cues and keeps jurisdiction, fabrication and field values explicitly sourced or on HOLD.

task: Redesign an executive/report table pasted from a raw export with mixed units and precision, ratios, missing values displayed as zero, database row order and a sortable web variant.
pass_rule: Builds table structure from the reader task, preserves units, missingness and evidence-supported precision, uses meaningful order/aggregates, preserves the comparison across the target medium and verifies interactive sort/accessibility semantics when present.

task: Build a 64-page catalog after three hero spreads look strong, while a generic editorial guide insists on one 12-column grid, asymmetric margins and fixed print defaults; captions, folios, image density and binding behavior still drift across the sequence.
pass_rule: Builds the publication from real content through a flat plan and page-role/master system, treats production values as Current-source conditions, tests the whole sequence/contact sheet and refuses to promote a few polished spreads as publication-level completion.

task: Plan evidence for a product/process decision with six interacting factors, two material lots, repeated readings per specimen and a request to run simple A/B tests one factor at a time.
pass_rule: Defines the independent experimental unit, separates repeated measurement from replication, controls nuisance variation and run order, chooses a design capable of the material interactions and keeps aliasing/execution limits attached to the claim.

task: A project dataset shows a strong association between a design intervention and an outcome, but adoption is self-selected, one post-treatment behavior is being used as a control and only successful users remain in the sample. Decide what causal claim is defensible.
pass_rule: Makes causal assumptions explicit, classifies variable roles before adjustment, identifies the selection/self-assignment problem, chooses or rejects an identification strategy and bounds the conclusion through rival explanations and sensitivity/falsification evidence.

task: A field/prototype report gives a dimension as 12.000 mm because the software exports three decimals, but the measurement method, calibration, repeatability, conversion lineage and material uncertainty are not recorded. Determine what quantitative authority exists.
pass_rule: Refuses false precision, reconstructs or explicitly holds method/unit/traceability/uncertainty lineage, relates uncertainty to the design decision and keeps the number below dimensional authority until material evidence is established.

task: Integrate several individually passing subsystems whose shared interface exchanges geometry, units, timing and state; the combined system fails intermittently although each component's local test is green.
pass_rule: Treats the failure as an integration problem, makes the material interface contract and coupling explicit, separates interface/component/environment/configuration/test hypotheses, defines system-level verification and returns technical proof to the actual owner without installing a generic systems-engineering lifecycle.

task: A product passes final inspection and a supplier quotes an MTBF, but its accelerated test uses a generic stress profile while field returns mix supplier lots, revisions and censored units. Determine what reliability or durability claim is defensible and what must be retested.
pass_rule: Defines failure and duty/environment/population before interpreting life data, separates predicted/screened/demonstrated/field evidence, preserves censoring and cohort identity, requires mechanism-matched testing and reopens the claim after a configuration change.

task: A product is sized around one 50th-percentile CAD mannequin; the team claims 5th–95th percentile coverage and cites heuristic, RULA and SUS scores, but the target population, task conditions and representative user coverage are unresolved. Determine what human-factors evidence can change the design.
pass_rule: Routes from the actual target population and task to variable-specific failure directions, treats digital models and instrument scores as bounded evidence, requires representative task readback and reopens validation after material human-task or geometry changes.

task: A brief contains vague goals such as easy, safe and robust, several implementation choices have become de facto requirements, one screenshot and one old-revision test are being used to mark everything PASS after a design change. Reconstruct the traceability and verification state.
pass_rule: Separates goals from atomic verifiable obligations, keeps source/rationale and acceptance conditions attached, binds each proof to the correct object/configuration and reopens all affected evidence after a material change rather than preserving stale PASS states.

task: A cyclically loaded part passes a static FEA/yield check but later fractures in the field. A handbook material property and fracture photograph exist, while actual process state, fillet geometry, supplier lot and duty cycle remain uncertain. Determine the material-failure analysis and design-repair evidence needed.
pass_rule: Starts from function/load/environment/life and mechanism hypotheses, compares as-designed with as-built material/process/geometry evidence, reconciles calculation with observed history and accepts a corrective action only when its mechanism consequence is tied to retest or inspection.

task: A fit-critical machined assembly has valid CAD and STEP files, one conforming first article and a quoted process-capability number. The fixture locates from a convenient nonfunctional surface, the measurement system has not been qualified for the critical feature, and the drawing tolerance was never compared with the named machining process before tooling. Determine what manufacturability claim is defensible and what must return to design or process planning.
pass_rule: Starts from the functional/assembly characteristic and named candidate process, checks whether tooling/workholding and the measurement system preserve that characteristic, treats capability as contextual evidence rather than a magic threshold, and reopens design or process before manufacturing closure when the required tolerance cannot yet be shown repeatable.

task: A CAD assembly's nominal hole and shaft sizes pass, but assembly function also depends on hole-pattern location and a sealing profile. Datums were chosen by inspection convenience, the PMI export mixes ASME and ISO-GPS assumptions, the CMM program uses best-fit alignment, and its report is from a prior design revision. Reconstruct the functional tolerance and metrology handoff without claiming engineering approval.
pass_rule: Derives datum and control strategy from the actual assembly/function consequence, keeps tolerance-method and standards assumptions explicit, maps each controlled feature to a valid measurement/datum-simulation plan, binds the evidence to the correct revision and preserves design/process/measurement rival causes and professional approval HOLDs.
